TITLE: Quality Engineer I
COMPANY: Fixture Aerospace Systems
LOCATION: Wichita, KS
LINK: https://example.invalid/jobs/3

About the Role

Join our airframe quality organization supporting composite structures production.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering. 0-2 years of experience.
- Hands-on experience with PFMEA and Control Plans is required.
- Must be proficient with GD&T and CMM inspection reports.
- AS9102 first article inspection (FAIR) experience required.
- 8D root cause analysis and CAPA required.

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to prepreg layup and autoclave cure preferred.
- SPC and process capability analysis is a plus.
- NDE familiarity desired.

Work Authorization

U.S. citizens, permanent residents and visa holders are all welcome to apply, and visa
sponsorship is available for this position including H-1B and STEM OPT candidates.
Fixture Aerospace Systems welcomes international applicants.

- 401k, equity, medical, dental.
